source: SWIFT Category 7 Message Reference Guide, Standards MT November 2025
scope: Issue of a Documentary Credit (Sender = Issuing Bank, Receiver = Advising Bank)

tags.definition: This field specifies the number of this message in the series of messages sent for a documentary credit, and the total number of messages in the series.

rules.description: Number must be exactly 1 numeric digit
Number must have the fixed value of 1
Total must be exactly 1 numeric digit
Total must be in the range 1 to 8

tags.definition: This field specifies the type of credit.

codes.meaning: The documentary credit is irrevocable
The documentary credit is irrevocable and transferable

usage_rules.text: Details of any special conditions applying to the transferability of the credit and/or the bank authorised to transfer the credit in a freely negotiable credit should be included in field 47A Additional Conditions.

rules.description: Type must contain one of the codes listed above

tags.definition: This field specifies the documentary credit number which has been assigned by the Sender.

rules.description: Must not start or end with '/' and must not contain '//'
Must not exceed 16 characters

tags.verification_note: Format/Presence confirmed from the MT700 Format Specifications table (16x, Optional). No NVR or Usage Rules section was located for this field under MT700's own Field Specifications despite multiple searches. Definition text below is not a directly-quoted MT700 sentence and should be re-checked against the PDF page (~p.18) before being treated as authoritative.
tags.definition: This field contains the reference to a related pre-advice, if a pre-advice was sent for this documentary credit.

rules.description: Must not exceed 16 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the date on which the issuing bank considers the documentary credit as being issued.

rules.description: Date must be a valid date expressed as YYMMDD

tags.definition: This field specifies the rules the credit is subject to.

codes.meaning: Subject to the ICC UCP version in effect on date of issue.
Subject to UCP + Uniform Rules for Bank-to-Bank Reimbursements, both in effect on date of issue.
Subject to the eUCP Supplement (electronic presentations), in effect on date of issue.
Subject to eUCP + URR, both in effect on date of issue.
Subject to another set of rules, or not subject to the version in effect on date of issue - these must be specified in Narrative (2nd subfield).

rules.description: Applicable Rules must not exceed 30 characters
Applicable Rules code must be one of the codes listed above
Narrative is only allowed if Applicable Rules is OTHR
Narrative must be provided when Applicable Rules is OTHR — derived from the OTHR code's own definition text, not a separate formal NVR
Narrative must not exceed 35 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the latest date for presentation under the documentary credit and the place where documents may be presented.

rules.description: Date must be a valid date expressed as YYMMDD
Place subfield is mandatory whenever tag 31D is present
Place must not exceed 29 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the bank of the applicant customer, if different from the issuing bank.

rules.description: Identifier Code / Name and Address must decompose into a recognized option (BIC shape or free-text shape)

Identifier Code must be a registered, live, correctly-branched financial institution BIC - checked against config/bic_directory_sample.json (small illustrative set, not a real SWIFT directory; code is determined dynamically by the lookup, see T27/T28/T29/T45/C05)
In option D, Name and Address must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies the party on behalf of whom the documentary credit is issued.

rules.description: Must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies the party in favour of whom the documentary credit is issued.

rules.description: If an Account prefix is present, it must not exceed 34 characters
Must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field contains the currency code and amount of the documentary credit.

usage_rules.text: Special information relative to the amount of the credit must be specified in field 39A Percentage Credit Amount Tolerance or field 39C Additional Amounts Covered.

rules.description: Currency must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
Integer part must have at least one digit; decimal comma mandatory and counted in max length; decimal digits must not exceed the currency's allowed precision

tags.definition: This field specifies the tolerance relative to the documentary credit amount as a percentage plus and/or minus that amount.

usage_rules.text: Tolerance 1 specifies a positive tolerance, the Tolerance 2 specifies a negative tolerance.

rules.description: Tolerance 1 must be 1 to 2 numeric digits
Tolerance 2 must be 1 to 2 numeric digits

tags.definition: This field specifies any additional amounts available to the beneficiary under the terms of the credit, such as insurance, freight, interest, etc.

rules.description: Must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field identifies the bank with which the credit is available (the place for presentation) and an indication of how the credit is available.

usage_rules.text: For credits subject to eUCP: if presentation of both electronic records and paper documents is allowed, the place for presentation of the electronic records as well as the place for presentation of the paper documents must be specified in field 47A and not in this field.
For credits subject to eUCP: if presentation of only electronic records is allowed, the place for presentation of the electronic records must be specified in field 47A and not in this field.

If the credit is to be freely negotiable by any bank, option D must be used with the phrase 'Any bank in ... (city or country)'. If freely negotiable anywhere in the world, an indication of country is not required.
When Code contains either BY DEF PAYMENT or BY MIXED PYMT, the specific details of the payment terms must be specified in fields 42P and 42M respectively.
When Code contains BY PAYMENT, this should be understood to mean payment at sight.

rules.description: In option A or D, Code must contain one of the codes listed above

constraint.reference: BIC directory — not checked against a real directory; shape check is used as a proxy

rules.description: Identifier Code must be a registered financial institution BIC

constraint.reference: BIC directory — not checked against a real directory; same proxy as R2

rules.description: Identifier Code must be a financial institution BIC (covers connected/non-connected/Master/Synonym/Live/Test destinations)

Identifier Code / Name and Address must decompose into a recognizable option (BIC shape or free-text shape) — this rule was missing from the original 11-tag migration, found while building the rule-execution engine
In option D, Name and Address must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies the tenor of drafts to be drawn under the documentary credit.

rules.description: Must not exceed 3 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field identifies the drawee of the drafts to be drawn under the documentary credit.

usage_rules.text: The drawee must be a bank. If drafts on the applicant are required, they are to be listed as documents in field 46A.
The Party Identifier must not be present.

rules.description: The Party Identifier must not be present
Identifier Code / Name and Address must decompose into a recognized option (BIC shape or free-text shape)

constraint.reference: BIC directory - not checked against a real directory; shape check is used as a proxy

rules.description: Identifier Code must be a registered financial institution BIC

constraint.reference: BIC directory - not checked against a real directory; same proxy as above

rules.description: Identifier Code must be a financial institution BIC (covers connected/non-connected/Master/Synonym/Live/Test destinations)
In option D, Name and Address must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies the payment dates, amounts and/or method for their determination in a documentary credit which is available by mixed payment.

rules.description: Must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies the payment date or method for its determination in a documentary credit which is available by deferred payment or negotiation only.

rules.description: Must not exceed 4 lines of 35 characters each

tags.definition: This field specifies whether or not partial shipments are allowed under the documentary credit.

codes.meaning: Allowed under the documentary credit.
Conditional based on conditions specified elsewhere in the message.
Not allowed under the documentary credit.

rules.description: Code must contain one of the codes listed above

tags.definition: This field specifies whether or not transhipment is allowed under the documentary credit.

codes.meaning: Allowed under the documentary credit.
Conditional based on conditions specified elsewhere in the message.
Not allowed under the documentary credit.

rules.description: Code must contain one of the codes listed above

tags.field_name: Place of Taking in Charge/Dispatch from .../Place of Receipt
tags.definition: This field specifies the place of taking in charge (in case of a multimodal transport document), the place of receipt (in case of a road, rail or inland waterway transport document or a courier or expedited delivery service document), the place of dispatch or the place of shipment to be indicated on the transport document.

rules.description: Must not exceed 140 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the port of loading or airport of departure to be indicated on the transport document.

rules.description: Must not exceed 140 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the port of discharge or airport of destination to be indicated on the transport document.

rules.description: Must not exceed 140 characters

tags.field_name: Place of Final Destination/For Transportation to .../Place of Delivery
tags.definition: This field specifies the final destination or place of delivery to be indicated on the transport document.

rules.description: Must not exceed 140 characters

tags.definition: This field specifies the latest date for loading on board/dispatch/taking in charge.

rules.description: Date must be a valid date expressed as YYMMDD

tags.definition: This field specifies the period of time during which the goods are to be loaded on board/despatched/taken in charge.

rules.description: Must not exceed 6 lines of 65 characters each

tags.definition: This field contains a description of the goods and/or services.

usage_rules.text: Terms such as FOB, CIF, etc. should be specified in this field.
The specification of each new item should begin on a new line, preceded by the sign '+' or numbered using +1), +2), etc.

rules.description: Must not exceed 100 lines of 65 characters each

tags.definition: This field contains a description of any documents required.

usage_rules.text: When the ultimate date of issue of a transport document is specified, it is to be specified with the relative document in this field.
For credits subject to eUCP, the format in which electronic records are to be presented must be specified in this field.
The specification of each new item should begin on a new line, preceded by the sign '+' or numbered using +1), +2), etc.

rules.description: Must not exceed 100 lines of 65 characters each

tags.definition: This field contains a description of further conditions of the documentary credit.

usage_rules.text: For credits subject to eUCP, where applicable, the place for presentation of electronic records (and paper documents, if both are allowed) must be specified in this field.
The specification of each new item should begin on a new line, preceded by the sign '+' or numbered using +1), +2), etc.

rules.description: Must not exceed 100 lines of 65 characters each

tags.verification_note: Format/Presence confirmed from MT700 table (100*65z, Optional). Definition text below is taken from the identically-worded field in a sibling message type (MT721), not a directly-quoted MT700-specific sentence. Recommend confirming against MT700 PDF page (~p.29) before treating as authoritative.
tags.definition: This field specifies special payment conditions applicable to the beneficiary, for example, post-financing request/conditions.

rules.description: Must not exceed 100 lines of 65 characters each

tags.field_name: Special Payment Conditions for Bank Only
tags.definition: This field specifies special payment conditions applicable to a bank without disclosure to the beneficiary, for example, post-financing request/conditions. Content of the field must specify to which bank it is addressed.

rules.description: Must not exceed 100 lines of 65 characters each

tags.definition: This field may be used only to specify charges to be borne by the beneficiary.

codes.meaning: Agent's Commission
Our Commission
Our Correspondent's Commission
Commercial Discount
Insurance Premium
Our Postage
Stamp Duty
Teletransmission Charges
Wharfing and Warehouse

usage_rules.text: In the absence of this field, all charges, except negotiation and transfer charges, are to be borne by the applicant.
usage_rules.note: References 'the applicant' by role, not field 50 by number.

usage_rules.text: Any code used in this field must be between slashes and must appear at the beginning of a line.
Narrative text must not begin with a slash and, if used, must begin on a new line and be the last information in the field.

tags.definition: This field specifies the number of calendar days after the date of shipment within which the documents must be presented for payment, acceptance, or negotiation. Narrative must only be used to specify another type of date than a shipment date, for example invoice date, from which the period for presentation begins.

usage_rules.text: The absence of this field means that the presentation period is 21 days after the date of shipment, where applicable.
usage_rules.note: References 'the date of shipment' by role, not field 44C/44D by number.

rules.description: Days must be 1 to 3 numeric digits
Narrative must not exceed 35 characters when present

tags.definition: This field contains confirmation instructions for the requested confirmation party.

codes.meaning: The requested confirmation party is requested to confirm the credit
The requested confirmation party may add its confirmation to the credit
No confirmation is requested

rules.description: Instruction must contain one of the codes listed above

tags.definition: Bank which is requested to add its confirmation or may add its confirmation.

usage_rules.text: Field must be present if confirmation instructions is MAY ADD or CONFIRM.

tags.definition: This field specifies the bank authorised to reimburse the paying, accepting or negotiating bank.

usage_rules.text: With the exception of a credit valid for negotiation, if there is a single direct account relationship, in the currency of the credit, between the Sender and the Receiver, the absence of field 53a means that this account relationship will be used for reimbursement.
usage_rules.note: References 'the currency of the credit' by role, not field 32B by number.

tags.definition: This field specifies instructions to the paying, accepting or negotiating bank. It may also indicate if pre-notification of a reimbursement claim or pre-debit notification to the issuing bank is required.

usage_rules.text: When used to indicate pre-notification of a reimbursement claim or pre-debit notification to the issuing bank is required, the number and type of days, that is, banking or calendar days, within which the issuing bank has to be notified should also be indicated.

rules.description: Must not exceed 12 lines of 65 characters each

structured_line_format.lines_2_6: [/8c/[additional information]] or [//continuation of additional information] or (Narrative)

tags.definition: This field specifies additional information for the Receiver.

codes.meaning: Please advise/contact the beneficiary by phone.
Please advise the beneficiary by the most efficient means of telecommunication.

message_level_network_validated_rules.text: When used, fields 42C and 42a must both be present.
Either fields 42C and 42a together, or field 42M alone, or field 42P alone may be present. No other combination of these fields is allowed.
message_level_network_validated_rules.note: C1 governs internal co-presence of the first group; evaluate C1 before C2.

message_level_network_validated_rules.text: Either field 44C or 44D, but not both, may be present.
Field 58a must be present if confirmation instructions (tag 49) is MAY ADD or CONFIRM.
message_level_network_validated_rules.note: Not an official SWIFT 'C' rule number — promoted here from tag 58a's usage_rules[0] (confidence: confirmed) since it's a cross-field concern, not a single-tag content check.
